research: Existing modular audits define scaffolds through src/tests or root contracts; directory depth alone is not module evidence.
The first tracked-file implementation was rejected after independent review measured 828543 of 1048576 output bytes, leaving insufficient growth headroom.
The accepted design reuses the existing trusted Git resolver and closed Git environment from repository audit discovery rather than creating a second Git authority implementation.
The exact-HEAD projection reads recursive directory metadata plus the immediate immutable tree object of each depth-three candidate in one bounded batch.

All ten exclusions lack direct src/tests trees and root README/INTERFACE blobs; telemetry feedback is excluded while HoloDAE and the doc-only consciousness engine remain available.

hard_think: Strict Tier-0 correctly rejected an incomplete target; the defect was false module inference, not fail-closed enforcement.
Evidence-qualified roots preserve legitimate doc-only modules without allowing data containers, report roots, archives, or organizational directories to poison basename intent.
Eight MiB per Git output supports the declared 4096-module ceiling at measured repository shape while scope, process count, batch input, time, cache, and returned roots remain separately bounded.
Candidate tests cannot replace merged exact-main refresh, resident replay of the original query, and immutable post-query replica verification.
dialectic_sweep: A feedback stopword would hide one symptom and remain vulnerable to the next container name.
Adding fake contracts to telemetry data would corrupt module semantics and weaken strict Tier-0.
Scanning every tracked file was functionally correct but did not scale with repository source volume.

Using inherited Git state or ambient PATH would make exact-HEAD evidence caller-steerable; trusted executable resolution, closed Git variables/config, no replacement refs, and no optional locks are mandatory.
first_principles: A module name is admitted by committed scaffold evidence, never directory depth or semantic-hit happenstance.
Full explicit module paths remain independently validated and do not consult the basename catalog.
Query-time discovery reads immutable Git metadata only; it never walks module files, opens the index store, reindexes, changes routes, or starts maintenance.
This slice fixes retrieval intent quality only; exact runtime closure, A-grade metrics, proposer/evaluator separation, promotion, canary, rollback, and outcome learning remain separate gates.
